title: Number ranges (SNRO)
description: Reads and maintains SNRO number range objects, their intervals, and draws next numbers.

objects.name: ZCL_ZMCP_X_NR
objects.description: fluid: number range objects and intervals

actions.name: list
actions.description: Lists number range objects matching a name pattern ('*' any chars, '+' one char). Reads texts in the given language, or the logon language by default. max_rows caps the result (0 or absent = no limit).

pattern.description: Object-name pattern; '*' matches any chars, '+' matches one char. Default '*'.

language.description: Text language key. Default: logon language.

max_rows.description: Row limit, as an integer written in text. 0 or absent means no limit.

actions.name: describe
actions.description: Reads one number range object's definition and its list of intervals.

language.description: Text language key. Default: logon language.

actions.name: create
actions.description: Creates a number range object via NUMBER_RANGE_OBJECT_UPDATE and NUMBER_RANGE_OBJECT_CLOSE (no direct table writes). Registers a TADIR R3TR NROB entry in the given package, and records it on corr_nr when the package is transportable; pass corr_nr "" for a $ package. text_short defaults to the first 20 chars of text, percentage to 10, buffer_size to 10; buffer_off true means no buffering, otherwise main-memory buffering.

object.description: Number range object name to create.

domain.description: Number-length domain, e.g. CHAR10 or NUMC10.

corr_nr.description: Transport request. Pass "" for a $ package.

text_short.description: Short text. Default: first 20 chars of text.

buffer_off.description: True disables buffering. Default: main-memory buffering.

actions.name: set_interval
actions.description: Creates or changes one number-range interval under the number-range lock, via NUMBER_RANGE_INTERVAL_LIST, NUMBER_RANGE_INTERVAL_UPDATE and NUMBER_RANGE_UPDATE_CLOSE. mode reports whether the interval was inserted or updated. Internal (non-external) numeric bounds are zero-padded to the object's domain length. nrlevel, the current number level, is only changed when supplied. toyear defaults to "0000".

external.description: True for external numbering (caller supplies numbers).

subobject.description: Subobject value, if the object has one.

toyear.description: Fiscal/calendar year for a year-dependent object. Default "0000".

nrlevel.description: Current number level. Only changed when supplied.

actions.name: get_next
actions.description: Draws the next number(s) from an interval with NUMBER_GET_NEXT. This consumes numbers: the interval level advances in the number range buffer, or for an unbuffered object in NRIV, persisted when the request ends (the plugin issues no COMMIT). ignore_buffer bypasses the buffer. quantity defaults to 1.

subobject.description: Subobject value, if the object has one.

toyear.description: Fiscal/calendar year for a year-dependent object.

quantity.description: How many numbers to draw, as an integer written in text. Default 1.

ignore_buffer.description: True reads/updates the database directly, bypassing the number range buffer.

actions.name: delete
actions.description: Deletes a number range object. Refuses if it still has intervals unless with_intervals is set; refuses if any interval is in use (number level not 0) unless force is set. Deletes intervals via the interval API, then the object via NUMBER_RANGE_OBJECT_DELETE, then cleans up the TADIR entry. package must match the object's registered package (or a $ package if it has no TADIR entry); corr_nr is required for a transportable package, "" otherwise.

object.description: Number range object name to delete.

package.description: Must match the object's TADIR package, or a $ package if it has none.

corr_nr.description: Transport request. Required for a transportable package, "" otherwise.

with_intervals.description: Also delete the object's intervals. Required if any exist.

force.description: Allow deleting intervals whose number level is not 0 (already in use).
